split.cross_asset_group: common UTC origin-date blocks, local timestamps retained; economic_entity grouping
split.history_insufficient: exploratory_or_unavailable; do not silently reduce required folds
split.purge: Earlier label interval cannot intersect protected next-partition origin/outcome region; earlier outcome_known_at must be strictly before next boundary.
split.embargo: exact task horizon plus one eligible valuation session before boundary; add actual publication lag; if later training rows ever allowed, embargo post-validation origins at least horizon
split.inner: three chronological splits wholly within fit region, purged at their boundaries; transformations fit inside each inner fit
split.calibration: selected estimator held fixed, sigmoid trained on separate purged chronological calibration block
split.final_test: quarantine all outcomes/access; one frozen candidate submission; any tuning afterwards marks test spent; new final test requires untouched or newly mature data

search_caps.scope_per_campaign: one declared task x horizon x market-kind group; all scopes retained but no all-horizon monthly implication
search_caps.rule: Any extra target head, quantile head, ablation or seed consumes remaining fit capacity or separate campaign; illustrative 92-fit schedule is for one scalar target, not six targets at once. Stop rather than exceed.
search_caps.configuration_bound_meaning: At most24declared learned configuration alternatives, sixinitially. R1linear/logisticbaselines count. Actually evaluated candidates/folds/heads must fit96cap;24isnot24xallfolds permission. All configurations and inner search declared before outer results.

live_trial.beat_meaning: owner_selected_2026-11-05 (OWN-33, "A lower score is enough"): the option read "The model must score better on average than each comparator on the same forecasts. Rules are scored through the frozen mapping." and its cost read "A small lead counts, and the 2% hurdle applies only to the earlier walk-forward test." So: a lower mean primary proper score (SCI-06) than each comparator on the trial's paired origins once they mature, with no 2% hurdle and no 95% interval in the trial, which the owner confirmed on 24 November 2026: MP203-06, 24 November 2026 (MP-203): the owner picked "Confirm: no hurdle, no interval" (pressed on the page). The option read: "A lower average score than each comparator on the same matured forecasts is enough in the trial. The 2% hurdle and the 95% interval stay in the walk-forward test only."; the base rate has a proper score directly, the current rules only through rules_proper_score

rules_proper_score.why: the rules produce only labelled heuristic strength (SCI-04), and only an independently qualified probability mapping may turn rule outputs into probabilities
rules_proper_score.proposal: R0-RULEMAP: a monotone sigmoid mapping from a rules version's heuristic strength to the task's event probability, fitted only on the purged chronological calibration block before the trial starts, then frozen and versioned; it must pass the SCI-05 calibration checks before it can stand as the rules comparator
rules_proper_score.rules_changes: the proposed and the current rules each get their own frozen mapping fitted on the same pre-trial block
rules_proper_score.no_qualified_mapping: owner_selected_2026-11-05 (ADM-09, "Use the best simple baseline"): the option read "For that task, the strongest simple baseline stands in for the rules, with your yes each time." So for that task the strongest simple baseline stands in for the rules, with the owner's yes each time; the rules are never given a fabricated probability
rules_proper_score.distribution_targets: owner_selected_2026-11-24 (MP203-05): MP203-05, 24 November 2026 (MP-203): the owner picked "Once, as a standing rule" (pressed on the page). The option read: "You approve once that for range tasks the strongest simple range baseline stands in for the rules. Each promotion screen names it, and you still approve every promotion." So for pinball-scored (range) targets, where the rules give no quantiles, the strongest eligible R0 distribution baseline stands in for the rules under the owner's one standing approval; each promotion screen names it, and the owner still approves every promotion. ADM-09's yes each time stays for event (probability) tasks without a qualified rules mapping

live_trial.unscoreable_week: A week that cannot be scored (a data outage, a holiday week) pauses the 8-week trial count; the trial still needs 8 scored weeks.

scored_week_by_horizon.sessions_1_5_10_20: a week counts when its trial origins were issued, or abstained with a reason code, cleanly; its origins are scored when they mature, and the verdict waits until the 8 counted weeks' origins have matured (up to 20 sessions plus publication lag after the last counted week)
scored_week_by_horizon.months_3_6_12: nothing issued in the trial matures inside 8 weeks, so a scored week is a clean-running week: every scheduled origin issued or abstained with a reason code by its deadline, a valid artefact hash, no safety trigger and no late input backdated
scored_week_by_horizon.not_clean: a week that is neither unscoreable nor clean fails the trial, which restarts from zero
scored_week_by_horizon.no_matured_forecasts_yet: not a reason to pause the count: maturity delays the verdict, not the count

live_trial.long_horizons: 3/6/12 months: the 8 weeks check clean running and calibration on what has matured; walk-forward history carries the accuracy evidence; the owner still approves
live_trial.long_horizon_comparison: 3/6/12 months: beating the base rate and the current rules is evidenced by the walk-forward history (SCI-05), not by trial origins
live_trial.long_horizon_calibration_check: open in SCI-D03: no trial forecast matures for 3/6/12 months, so 'calibrated on what has matured' has no trial outcomes; proposed: the frozen candidate replayed point-in-time on the latest matured walk-forward origins, labelled replay, not prospective evidence
live_trial.rules_changes: indicators, pillars and thresholds take the same 8-week shadow trial, beating the current rules, before the owner approves
live_trial.self_correction_during_trial: candidate runs the same bounded code as live (proposed)
